concerns.text: FR-012 states that predictor streams must be derived solely from content the user is *exposed to*, while the outcome stream must come exclusively from the user's own comments. However, FR-013 defines `exposure_level` as the proportion of comments the user has *viewed* from target subreddits, which can only be estimated from the user's own comment history (the same Reddit comment stream used to compute `self_eval_score`). This makes the predictor (`exposure_level`) a summary of the same data that generates the outcome, violating Constitution Principle VI and creating a circular, tautological validation of moderation effects.

The definition of `exposure_level` as a proportion of the user's own comments from target subreddits (i.e., “proportion of comments the user has viewed from identified idealized‑self‑presentation subreddits”) relies on the same comment stream that is later used to compute `self_eval_score`. Consequently, the predictor and outcome are not independent data streams, undermining the causal interpretation of any moderation effect and rendering the regression analysis scientifically invalid.
